name: Custom Shape Wooden Candy Basket
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood for a sturdy, durable, and long-lasting structure.
    - Crafted from 3mm wooden panels for a lightweight yet stable finish.
    - Smooth wooden surface helps display printed artwork and colors clearly.
    - Features a solid assembled structure suitable for holding lightweight treats and small gifts.
    - Includes a built-in handle for convenient carrying and display.
    - Natural wooden construction adds a warm, rustic, and decorative look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Basket body size: 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    - Overall height: 6 in ~ 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features double-sided printing on the custom-shaped front and back panels.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative wooden candy basket for treats, snacks, and small gift items.
    - Suitable for holding candies, chocolates, mini toys, wrapped treats, and party favors.
    - Built-in handle makes it easy to carry, gift, or display.
    - Great for Halloween trick-or-treat baskets, holiday gift baskets, and themed party décor.
    - Can be used as a tabletop decoration for parties, candy stations, dessert tables, and event setups.
    - Suitable for home décor, classroom celebrations, seasonal displays, and gift presentation.
    - Reusable design allows the basket to be used year after year for different occasions.
    - Works well as both a functional container and a decorative keepsake piece.
    - Ideal for personalized gifting with names, characters, and holiday-themed artwork.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for Halloween, Christmas, birthdays, and seasonal celebrations.
    - Great for kids, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - A fun gift choice for trick-or-treat events, classroom parties, and holiday gatherings.
    - Suitable for personalized candy baskets, party favors, and themed gift baskets.
    - Ideal for home decorators who enjoy seasonal and custom wooden décor.
    - A charming keepsake gift that combines both decoration and practical use.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Candy Basket

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
